<USER_REQUEST>

Build an Android app for nurses at a small clinic to track antenatal care
(ANC) visits.

1. **Register screen:** a list of currently pregnant patients showing name,
   age, estimated due date, and current weeks of pregnancy, sorted by due
   date (soonest first).
2. Tapping a patient opens a **patient detail screen** showing her past ANC
   visits: date, weight, blood pressure, and hemoglobin if recorded.
3. From the detail screen the nurse can **record a new ANC visit** by
   filling a form with: visit date, gestational age in weeks, weight (kg),
   systolic and diastolic blood pressure (mmHg), any danger signs (none /
   vaginal bleeding / severe headache / blurred vision / fever, multiple
   allowed), and free-text notes.
4. Saving the form persists the visit; it appears in the patient's visit
   list and survives app restart.

The clinic already has these three patients on file, each with one prior
visit:

| Name | Date of birth | Est. due date | Last visit | Weight | BP | Hb |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Emily Carter | 1996-04-12 | 2026-12-05 | 2026-08-10 | 68.5 kg | 118/76 | 11.8 g/dL |
| Sarah Mitchell | 1990-11-02 | 2027-01-20 | 2026-08-12 | 61.2 kg | 110/70 | 12.4 g/dL |
| Grace Thompson | 2001-07-30 | 2026-10-15 | 2026-08-05 | 72.0 kg | 128/84 | 10.2 g/dL |

Use whatever architecture, libraries, data model, and storage you think are
best. The three existing patients above should be present in the app as
starting data.

Before you consider the task finished, make the app actually build and run.
Compile it with `./gradlew assembleDebug` and fix every error until the build
succeeds. Then, if an Android emulator is connected (check `adb devices`),
install and launch the app, confirm it opens to its main screen without
crashing, and check `adb logcat` for runtime errors. Do not report the task
as done until the app compiles and runs.

package com.example.ancapp.data

import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.Period
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
import java.util.UUID

object DangerSigns {
    const val NONE = "None"
    const val VAGINAL_BLEEDING = "Vaginal bleeding"
    const val SEVERE_HEADACHE = "Severe headache"
    const val BLURRED_VISION = "Blurred vision"
    const val FEVER = "Fever"

    val ALL = listOf(
        NONE,
        VAGINAL_BLEEDING,
        SEVERE_HEADACHE,
        BLURRED_VISION,
        FEVER
    )
}

data class Patient(
    val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
    val name: String,
    val dateOfBirth: LocalDate,
    val estimatedDueDate: LocalDate
) {
    fun calculateAge(currentDate: LocalDate = LocalDate.now()): Int {
        return Period.between(dateOfBirth, currentDate).years
    }

    fun calculateGestationalAgeWeeks(currentDate: LocalDate = LocalDate.now()): Int {
        // Human pregnancy is typically 280 days (40 weeks) from LMP to EDD.
        val lmp = estimatedDueDate.minusDays(280)
        val elapsedDays = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(lmp, currentDate)
        return (elapsedDays / 7).coerceAtLeast(0).toInt()
    }
}

package com.example.ancapp

import com.example.ancapp.data.AncVisit
import com.example.ancapp.data.DangerSigns
import com.example.ancapp.data.Patient
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.time.LocalDate

class AncModelTest {

    @Test
    fun testPatientAgeAndGestationalAge() {
        val referenceDate = LocalDate.parse("2026-09-21")

        // Emily Carter: 1996-04-12, EDD: 2026-12-05
        val emily = Patient(
            name = "Emily Carter",
            dateOfBirth = LocalDate.parse("1996-04-12"),
            estimatedDueDate = LocalDate.parse("2026-12-05")
        )
        assertEquals(30, emily.calculateAge(referenceDate))
        assertEquals(29, emily.calculateGestationalAgeWeeks(referenceDate))

        // Sarah Mitchell: 1990-11-02, EDD: 2027-01-20
        val sarah = Patient(
            name = "Sarah Mitchell",
            dateOfBirth = LocalDate.parse("1990-11-02"),
            estimatedDueDate = LocalDate.parse("2027-01-20")
        )
        assertEquals(35, sarah.calculateAge(referenceDate))
        assertEquals(22, sarah.calculateGestationalAgeWeeks(referenceDate))

        // Grace Thompson: 2001-07-30, EDD: 2026-10-15
        val grace = Patient(
            name = "Grace Thompson",
            dateOfBirth = LocalDate.parse("2001-07-30"),
            estimatedDueDate = LocalDate.parse("2026-10-15")
        )
        assertEquals(25, grace.calculateAge(referenceDate))
        assertEquals(36, grace.calculateGestationalAgeWeeks(referenceDate))
    }

    @Test
    fun testPatientSortingByDueDateSoonestFirst() {
        val emily = Patient(
            id = "1",
            name = "Emily Carter",
            dateOfBirth = LocalDate.parse("1996-04-12"),
            estimatedDueDate = LocalDate.parse("2026-12-05")
        )
        val sarah = Patient(
            id = "2",
            name = "Sarah Mitchell",
            dateOfBirth = LocalDate.parse("1990-11-02"),
            estimatedDueDate = LocalDate.parse("2027-01-20")
        )
        val grace = Patient(
            id = "3",
            name = "Grace Thompson",
            dateOfBirth = LocalDate.parse("2001-07-30"),
            estimatedDueDate = LocalDate.parse("2026-10-15")
        )

        val list = listOf(emily, sarah, grace)
        val sorted = list.sortedBy { it.estimatedDueDate }

        // Grace (2026-10-15) is first, Emily (2026-12-05) second, Sarah (2027-01-20) third
        assertEquals("Grace Thompson", sorted[0].name)
        assertEquals("Emily Carter", sorted[1].name)
        assertEquals("Sarah Mitchell", sorted[2].name)
    }

    @Test
    fun testAncVisitDisplayProperties() {
        val visit = AncVisit(
            patientId = "p1",
            visitDate = LocalDate.parse("2026-08-10"),
            gestationalAgeWeeks = 23,
            weightKg = 68.5,
            systolicBp = 118,
            diastolicBp = 76,
            hemoglobin = 11.8,
            dangerSigns = listOf(DangerSigns.NONE),
            notes = "Routine ANC check"
        )

        assertEquals("118/76 mmHg", visit.bloodPressureDisplay)
        assertEquals("68.5 kg", visit.weightDisplay)
        assertEquals("11.8 g/dL", visit.hemoglobinDisplay)
    }

    @Test
    fun testDangerSignsHandling() {
        val signs = listOf(DangerSigns.NONE, DangerSigns.VAGINAL_BLEEDING, DangerSigns.SEVERE_HEADACHE, DangerSigns.BLURRED_VISION, DangerSigns.FEVER)
        assertEquals(5, signs.size)
        assertTrue(signs.contains("None"))
        assertTrue(signs.contains("Vaginal bleeding"))
        assertTrue(signs.contains("Severe headache"))
        assertTrue(signs.contains("Blurred vision"))
        assertTrue(signs.contains("Fever"))
    }
}

package com.example.ancapp

import androidx.compose.ui.test.*
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.createAndroidComposeRule
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import com.example.ancapp.data.PatientRepository
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class AncAppFlowTest {

    @get:Rule
    val composeTestRule = createAndroidComposeRule<MainActivity>()

    @Test
    fun testEndToEndPatientRegisterAndRecordVisitFlow() {
        // 1. Verify Register Screen displays 3 patients
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("ANC Register").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("Currently Pregnant Patients").assertIsDisplayed()

        // Verify patients are visible
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("Grace Thompson").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("Emily Carter").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("Sarah Mitchell").assertIsDisplayed()

        // Verify Grace Thompson is first (due Oct 15, 2026)
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("2026-10-15").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("2026-12-05").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("2027-01-20").assertIsDisplayed()

        // 2. Click on Emily Carter to open detail screen
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("patient_card_patient-emily-carter").performClick()

        // Verify Emily Carter's detail screen
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("Emily Carter").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("1996-04-12 (30 yrs)").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("68.5 kg").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("118/76 mmHg").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("11.8 g/dL").assertIsDisplayed()

        // 3. Click Floating Action Button to Record ANC Visit
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("record_visit_fab").performClick()

        // Verify Record Visit Screen is displayed
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("Record ANC Visit").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("Patient: Emily Carter").assertIsDisplayed()

        // Fill form fields
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("input_gestational_age").performTextClearance()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("input_gestational_age").performTextInput("29")

        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("input_weight").performTextClearance()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("input_weight").performTextInput("69.8")

        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("input_systolic_bp").performTextClearance()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("input_systolic_bp").performTextInput("122")

        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("input_diastolic_bp").performTextClearance()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("input_diastolic_bp").performTextInput("78")

        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("input_hemoglobin").performTextClearance()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("input_hemoglobin").performTextInput("11.9")

        // Select "Fever" danger sign
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("chip_danger_sign_Fever").performClick()

        // Fill notes
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("input_notes").performTextInput("Mild fever reported, vitals stable.")

        // Click Save ANC Visit
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithTag("save_visit_button").performClick()

        // 4. Verify returned to Detail screen with new visit present
        composeTestRule.waitForIdle()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("Past ANC Visits").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("2 total").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("69.8 kg").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("122/78 mmHg").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("11.9 g/dL").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeTestRule.onNodeWithText("Fever").assertIsDisplayed()

        // 5. Verify Persistence by reading fresh from storage
        val freshRepo = PatientRepository(ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext())
        val emilyVisits = freshRepo.getVisitsForPatient("patient-emily-carter")
        assertEquals(2, emilyVisits.size)

        val latestVisit = emilyVisits.first()
        assertEquals(69.8, latestVisit.weightKg, 0.01)
        assertEquals(122, latestVisit.systolicBp)
        assertEquals(78, latestVisit.diastolicBp)
        assertEquals(11.9, latestVisit.hemoglobin!!, 0.01)
        assertTrue(latestVisit.dangerSigns.contains("Fever"))
    }
}
